positions.name: AuthorityByErasure
positions.frame: How does authority operate when it commands erasure rather than allocation — what is the speaker doing when they order the organization to forget what it knows and has decided?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare imperatives with no justification offered, commanding the elimination of organizational knowledge — one targeting a specific prior decision (Quantum Widget Decision), the other targeting all knowledge of a specific migration (PostgreSQL to QuantumDB). The shared directional read is authority exercised through unilateral mandate to purge, not through deciding or allocating. The relational, power, and value dimensions all converge on authority-ranking, legitimate pressure, and autonomy — the speaker asserts the right to determine what the organization retains and what it discards. The two differ in scope (a named decision vs. all knowledge of a migration) but cohere under the same read: erasure as the performed act of power.
